pages.title: Topological Circuit Board
pages.text: A circuit board whose traces are protected by topology. No defect or stray field can interrupt the current running around their edges. It is dark grey, with faintly shimmering lines along every trace.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Topological Phase Transmuter, I printed Topological Insulator traces on a Metamaterial Substrate with a Femtoscale Inductor and Quantum-Dot Photoresist. The traces could not be broken.
Made in $(item)Topological Phase Transmuter$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Assembly Lines.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Hyperdimensional Processor, Self-Healing Polymer, Topological Processor.
